text_block_list.text:
The final day of summer camp. We were scheduled
to head back to the academy after lunch.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna go grab some dessert!
Hey, mind if I bring back enough for everyone while I'm at it?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume at the Table
text_block_list.text:
Wah. Thanks a bunch~!
Ines, take it away~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Mont Blanc.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oh? McQueen-chan? ...Hmm-mm?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Was today's dessert your absolute favorite?
Want my portion of Mont Blanc too?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh!? T-That is unacceptable!
I am currently refraining from such things!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
To claim the Shield at the Tenno Sho (Autumn),
sacrifices are necessary...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oh dear~...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...So yeah, that's the story.
Macqueen-chan is just so stoic, you know.
She's even holding back on her favorite sweets...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Because McQueen believes winning the Shield is her duty as a Mejiro.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"...Or rather, you know,
I've been thinking about this ever since the Tenno Sho (Spring)."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Looking at Ryan-chan and the others,
I can't help but admire just how amazing ojousamas are~

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Eeeek?!
Me, a highborn lady?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. It's like the kind of strength you only get from a prestigious house.
Or rather, getting strong for everyone's sake.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: It's like she repays the expectations placed on her in full, giving strength to everyone...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"...I really want to shoulder everyone's voices properly too.
I wanna become like the two of them~."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, really... Haha, so that's how it is.
But in that case—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: You're Ines, not a Mejiro. You don't have to carry that burden, do you?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
What?!
Are you saying I can't do it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"N-No, that's completely wrong!!
Hmm... how should I put it?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: As long as you keep looking forward in your own way, we'll dream our own dreams through you.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ah—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Because through you,
I saw my own dream."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"...Ryan-chan, you told me something similar
back during the Derby, didn't you?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Haha! Did you notice?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I think that's just how it is.
Because your strength was different from mine,
I was saved by you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Wait, d-did I just say
something totally embarrassing!?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, why are you being so shy?
Even though you're explaining it in such nice words.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"...*ahem*. Anyway, my advice to you
is why don't you talk to your Trainer directly about it?"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...? With Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. After all, I'm your closest fan.
I bet I've had the answer you're looking for this whole time!
